Yes, you can return it! Since the soil is opened, it normally can't be returned—**but opened soil can be returned if it's faulty or incorrect, which yours is.**

Here's what to do:
1. Start the return from "My Orders"
2. You'll get a prepaid return label via email (it expires after 7 days, so drop it off quickly)
3. Since this is our error (wrong item), the return is free and you'll get a full refund

The refund will be issued within **5 business days** of the soil reaching our warehouse, back to your original payment method.
